events.title: Flashes of Chaos | Releasing On November 6, 2026
events.summary: Great news! It’s finally here! Flashes of Chaos is releasing on November 6, 2026! I’ve been working on Flashes of Chaos for two years now, and can’t wait for you guys to finally play the full game. Thank you so much for all the support along the way. I hope you have as much fun playing it as it was making it. Have fun, and let the chaos begin!
